How do I book a trip?

Choose a trip and vehicle, then send your enquiry on WhatsApp. Owner Hemanth Kumar handles payment and booking confirmation directly. An enquiry is not a confirmed booking, and no payment is taken on this website.
Can I change the temples or number of days?
Yes. Use the custom trip planner or tell the owner what you need on WhatsApp. The route and date are confirmed directly with the owner.
Will you book Tirumala darshan tickets?
We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.
Can older people and children travel with us?
Yes. Tell us about walking needs, rest breaks and luggage so the owner can help plan a suitable trip and vehicle.
Can you pick us up from an airport or station?
Yes. Share your arrival place and time on WhatsApp. The owner will confirm pickup arrangements.
What if I have not chosen a travel date?
You can send an enquiry now and discuss the travel date with the owner later.
How do cancellations, refunds and date changes work?
All cancellation, refund and date-change terms are handled directly with owner Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp. Ask for the terms for your trip in writing before making a payment.
Are vehicles and hotel rooms confirmed when I choose them?
No. Your selections are preferences for an enquiry. The owner confirms the vehicle, accommodation, availability and booking details directly on WhatsApp.
